simple.meaning: קְרִיּוֹת (Qᵉrîyôwth) is a Hebrew word meaning “Kerioth , the name of two places in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: קְרִיּוֹת (H7152) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Joshua 15:25, with occurrences in Joshua, Jeremiah, Amos.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קְרִיּוֹת (H7152) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in קְרִיּוֹת (H7152) before moving outward to related references.

definitions.short: Kerioth , the name of two places in Palestine
definitions.full: H7152. Qeriyyoth קרִיּוֺת proper name, of a location (formed as plural intensive from קִרְיָה ?); — 1 in Judah Josh 15:25 ( αἱ πόλεις ; whence, as supposed, Judas קְרִיּוֺת אִישׁ ), perhaps †aryatên , approximately 12 miles south of Hebron, Buhl Geogr. 182. 2 in Moab , Καριωθ , αἱ πόλεις ; MI 13 קרית : Jer 48:24 , ׳הַקּ 48:41 ; Amos 2:2 ; perhaps = Ραββαθ Μωαβ = Μοαβ = Αρεοπολις (Euseb., see Lag Onom. 277, 60 and others), modern Rabba , approximately 11 miles south of Arnon, compare Buhl Geogr. 270 .
